decisions.reason: The enumeration-mode requirement does not change any ESP32 GPIO assignment or availability constraint.
The source concerns native USB enumeration on integrated boards and does not change the three-board interboard connector or its D+/D- pinout.
Native USB enumeration modes do not affect I2C pull-ups, series resistors, speed, or interboard cable constraints.
The source reports that power operates correctly and does not change the interboard power topology, connectors, or distribution rules.
Testing three integrated samples does not change the already established integrated-board architecture or its retained-functionality requirement.
The native USB enumeration requirement has no necessary effect on the addressable LED supply, data drive, or component selection.
The source does not alter the e-paper backlight supply, switching, PWM, or fallback configuration.
The successful power observation is execution status and must not be propagated as a requirement-state change; no AXP2101 rule is modified.
Native USB enumeration modes do not affect the PIR sensor connector, output logic, or bias configuration.
The source does not change any panel button or switch GPIO assignment, bias, or active-level behavior.
Normal and forced-download USB enumeration requirements do not change the separate panel reset connector or EN-to-GND action.
The native USB requirement does not alter capacitive-touch GPIO assignments, output behavior, or pull-down configuration.
